description_en: Queries the list of sensitive field recognition methods in Data Protection Umbrella by calling the QueryRecognizeDataByRuleType operation
description_zh: 调用QueryRecognizeDataByRuleType接口获取数据保护伞的敏感字段识别方式列表
name: QueryRecognizeDataByRuleType

parameters.help_en:
The recognition rule type. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746905.html operation to obtain the rule types.
1: regular expression
2: built-in model
3: sample library
4: auto-generated model
parameters.help_zh:
识别规则类型。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746905.html接口获取规则的类型。
1：正则表达式
2：内置模型
3：样本库
4：自生成模型
parameters.name: recognize_rules_type

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID. Log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the DataStudio page, click the username in the upper-right corner, and choose Menu > User Info to obtain the tenant ID.

You can also obtain the tenant ID from Data.TenantId in the response of the GetProject operation
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID。

也可通过 GetProject 响应中的 Data.TenantId 获取
parameters.name: tenant_id

Data.description_en: The returned data in JSON format

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
